summary: Master institutional equity strategies, ESG integration, and risk attribution. Join our 5-day expert-led course for pension fund managers. Enroll today.
lede: Equity market strategies for pension funds focus on allocating and managing public-equity portfolios against long-term retirement liabilities. Designed for pension fund investment officers, portfolio managers, trustees and risk analysts, the course covers strategic and tactical allocation, factor investing, and liquidity-aware portfolio construction. Participants also practice equity risk measurement, performance attribution, and ESG integration through portfolio analysis and reporting exercises.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for institutional investment professionals who bear the responsibility of managing large-scale equity portfolios within a pension or retirement fund context.
audience: ESG Integration Specialists focused on sustainable equity
modules: Equity Market Foundations and Institutional Mandates
Portfolio Construction and Strategic Asset Allocation
Active Management and Factor Investing Strategies
ESG Integration and Sustainable Equity Investing
Digital Transformation and AI in Equity Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of financial markets and basic statistical concepts. Experience in investment operations or fund administration is recommended. No prior coding or programming knowledge is required, as the course focuses on the operational application of models rather than technical engineering.
